mapper.select: SELECT d.* FROM sys_dict_data d LEFT JOIN sys_dict_type t ON d.dict_type_id = t.id WHERE t.dict_type = #{dictType} ORDER BY d.dict_sort
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_dict_data(dict_type_id, dict_label, dict_value, dict_sort, status, create_time) VALUES(#{dictTypeId}, #{dictLabel}, #{dictValue}, #{dictSort}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_dict_data SET dict_type_id = #{dictTypeId}, dict_label = #{dictLabel}, dict_value = #{dictValue}, dict_sort = #{dictSort}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
